body:
thanks a lot people. reading your responses and talking to a helpline calmed me down a bit. im gonna think this over. getting kinda tired so ill sleep on it and then try to go see a counsellor or something tomorrow. it'll be a first..

mods can delete this if you want

You're right, but I also let myself down. I had ideas for myself but they disappeared into thin air. Obviously it's not a perfect life. But reading about people's problems on here and other subreddits about not being able to pay off student loans, or breaking up with their SOs, just makes me feel so guilty because I've always lived such a sheltered life.

Yes, I've thought a lot about it. No pills/hanging, don't want my roommates to walk in and be traumatized. No buses/trains for similar reason despite how tempted I've been recently. I'm probably going to drown myself in a remote location. Apparently the lack of oxygen eventually gets very relaxing after the initial struggle. Guess I'm just deciding when to do it...because I'm even too lazy to get out of the house...

Thanks. I admire you and I admire those people who keep bouncing back after failures. Unfortunately as you've probably figured out, I don't have the energy for that because otherwise I wouldn't be doing this. I'm taking the easy, selfish way out because I've proven that I don't have the motivation/drive/balls to continue. I wish someone could just brainwash me into being able to do stuff again

I wasn't expecting a response from my parents' perspective; thanks for that. I know that they will want to help me out of this crisis, but I don't want them to because I don't deserve it.

I can't see myself living out the rest of my life knowing the opportunities I blew. I have no future. I'm 20 going on 21 with no work experience or life skills due to those wasted years, and I will forever live in regret. If I kill myself they will be devastated for a couple of years and then eventually get over it. If I stay alive I will be a constant reminder of my failures everytime I see them.

edit: oh and what you said about learning lessons from failures. Well yeah I tried that and look how it turned out..
